title: Surjective pullback of etale module sheaves is faithful
statement: For schemes T and Tprime [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a commutative ring Λ, and a surjective scheme morphism π:Tprime→T [def-weil-surjective-morphism], the inverse image functor on small etale sheaves of Λ-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is faithful.

proof.text: The geometric points obtained by composing the algebraic-closure points of Tprime with π cover T, since π is surjective. Their stalk functors form a conservative family, including for module-valued sheaves. If π*φ=π*ψ, then the inverse-image stalk comparison identifies the image of φ−ψ at each of these points with the image of the zero map π*(φ−ψ). Hence every such stalk map is zero; conservativity and exactness of the stalks force φ−ψ=0, so φ=ψ. This is exactly the proof in the attached source declaration, with no finiteness or etaleness assumption on π.
